title: Sanford-Springvale Historical Society

services.name: Events & Exhibits
services.desc: Our collections are available to the public during open hours and special tours. We also host lectures, concerts, and other live events, including several at Sanford’s historic Sweat-Morin Homestead. Step back to 1775, when rebel units evolved from farmers and militia into a coordinated, effective fighting force with improved decorum. The Sanford-Springvale Historical Museum is thrilled to welcome back Russian-American virtuosos Ilya Kazantsev and Sergey Antonov.
